reasons.dead|div#mapMode: the map is the operating table and the tour control is a strip docked at its top-left corner; the space under the strip is the map the strip drives, and the map is the subject of the page, not a gap in it.
reasons.dead|div#satHud: the scope panel is docked at the map's top-right corner, over the territory it counts; the space under the panel is that territory, and the panel is the only thing in the hero that says what is in view.
reasons.dead|div#heroCityLabel: the city name is painted onto the map canvas; the element is a one-pixel anchor for that name, so the space around it is the map the name is written on.
reasons.dead|div.hero-map-space: on a phone the map runs full-bleed behind the headline, so this spacer holds the map's height and the headline begins below the map instead of over it.
reasons.dead|div.hero-proof: the decision console is the last block in the hero's right column, and the three figures under it are the page's own summary row; the space under the console is the gap between the console and those figures.
reasons.dead|span.field-band__point-num: the number is a hanging marker in the margin of the paragraph it numbers; the paragraph's own text fills that column, so the space under the marker is the paragraph, not a hole.
reasons.dead|div.sys-cell__head: the space under the card head is the system's own screenshot, always 21:8, so every catalogue card is the same height and a row of cards reads as one row rather than as a staircase.
reasons.scattered|div#heroNodeRail: the four theatre cards are one row of a four-column grid, all four visible at once because they are the same kind of choice — which theatre to watch — and the active one is marked.
reasons.dead|aside#caseStudyList: the list is a selector, not a column of content: it holds three records and the record's own fifteen fields run far below them, so the rail ends where its records end. The rail is sticky, so it follows the reader down the form.
